description: Create a Xero inventory/product item. Items can be sales-only, purchase-only, or tracked inventory (requires IsTrackedAsInventory + InventoryAssetAccountCode).

Code.description: User-defined item code (required, unique within tenant).

InventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Inventory asset account code (required when IsTrackedAsInventory is true).

IsPurchased.description: True if item is available for purchase (appears on bills).

IsSold.description: True if item is available for sale (appears on invoices).

IsTrackedAsInventory.description: True to track stock on hand — requires InventoryAssetAccountCode.

PurchaseDetails.description: Purchase pricing: UnitPrice, AccountCode (expense account), TaxType.

SalesDetails.description: Sales pricing: UnitPrice, AccountCode (revenue account), TaxType.

name: create_item
